security_audit.summary: Sixteen findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, metadata URLs, and relative documentation links. The shell template on SKILL.md line 49 is confirmed because it executes an external Python script while leaving the domain placeholder unquoted, creating command-injection risk if substituted through a shell. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The ledger command uses an unquoted domain placeholder and embeds variable data in a shell string.
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured argument array, validate domains and keywords, serialize data safely, and require confirmation before executing the external Python script.

content.user_title: Track Search Rankings and SERP Changes
content.value_statement: Ranking changes are difficult to compare across tools and exports. This skill builds sourced snapshots, calculates deltas, and highlights priorities.
actual_capabilities: Configures tracking by domain, keyword, market, device, language, priority, and competitor.
Compares current positions with a prior baseline and labels each ranking delta.
Identifies gains, declines, new rankings, lost rankings, and stable keywords.
Tracks SERP feature ownership, including snippets, local packs, images, videos, and related features.
Reports AI visibility metrics when measured data is available.
Produces sourced ranking summaries with likely causes and prioritized follow-up actions.
limitations: It requires connected tools, exports, or user-provided positions for measured ranking data.
It does not create reliable historical deltas when no prior baseline exists.
SERP features and AI visibility remain N/A when supporting data is unavailable.
It does not provide multi-metric stakeholder reporting or automated alert management.

use_cases.title: Review weekly keyword movement
use_cases.description: Compare weekly exports, identify the largest changes, and prioritize investigation.

use_cases.title: Monitor client search visibility
use_cases.description: Create a sourced ranking summary across markets, devices, competitors, and SERP features.

use_cases.title: Assess content performance
use_cases.description: Track target queries after content updates and separate measured movement from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a ranking snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Track current rankings for [domain] using these keywords: [keywords]. Label each position by source and mark missing values as N/A.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup with a keyword list

prompt_templates.title: Compare ranking periods
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this ranking export with [baseline date]. Show gains, losses, new rankings, lost rankings, and the largest changes.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze search features
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze SERP feature and AI visibility changes for [domain] across [markets]. Separate measured, user-provided, estimated, and unavailable values.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate competitor threats
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a ranking analysis for [domain] versus [competitors]. Identify share-of-voice threats, likely causes, controls, and prioritized recovery actions.

output_examples.input: Compare two weekly ranking exports for an ecommerce domain.
output: Summary: eight keywords improved, three declined, and two entered the top ten.
Biggest gain: running shoes moved from position 12 to 7, measured from the supplied exports.
Priority: investigate the product-page term that fell from position 4 to 11.

output_examples.input: Create a first ranking snapshot with no baseline.
output: Baseline status: first snapshot, so every change value is N/A.
Coverage: current positions are grouped by market, device, and source.
Next action: repeat the same checks next week to establish comparable deltas.

output_examples.input: Review AI visibility and SERP features for a software brand.
output: AI visibility: citation data is unavailable and marked N/A.
SERP features: the brand owns one measured featured snippet and two video results.
Opportunity: improve pages ranking below feature-owning competitors for high-priority queries.

best_practices: Use the same market, device, language, and source when comparing snapshots.
Label every metric as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.
Investigate large changes against competitors, controls, and recent site changes.
anti_patterns: Do not invent previous positions when no baseline exists.
Do not present estimated rankings as measured results.
Do not attribute every ranking change to one action without supporting evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch ranking data automatically?
faq.answer: Only when a compatible connector is available. Otherwise, it uses user-provided exports or positions.

faq.question: Can it work without a previous baseline?
faq.answer: Yes. It records the current results as the first snapshot and marks all deltas as N/A.

faq.question: How does it handle missing metrics?
faq.answer: It marks unavailable metrics as N/A instead of inventing values.

faq.question: Can it save monitoring results?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks for approval before writing a reusable summary to memory/monitoring/.

faq.question: Does it support AI visibility tracking?
faq.answer: Yes, when measured citation data is available. Otherwise, AI visibility is marked N/A.

faq.question: Can it create automated alerts?
faq.answer: No. Use a performance monitoring workflow for recurring reports and alert management.
